svg.title: Figure 1: Semantic Folding 6-stage retrieval pipeline
svg.desc: Two-row flowchart showing the SF pipeline. Top row: stages 1-3 (offline indexing). Bottom row: stages 4-6 leading to ranked results. A query input feeds into stage 6.

text.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11); fill: rgb(82, 81, 78); font-family: ABeeZee; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; text-anchor: middle; white-space: pre;
